technical.summary: Mixed technical setup with long-term bullish structure (50/200 SMA, supertrend) but conflicting intermediate signals (price below 50-SMA, below Ichimoku cloud, negative AO) and neutral sector momentum limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: UNH shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 38 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (11/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional insider selling by senior Republican McCaul across three recent transactions creates conflicting signals; lack of news data limits conviction.

risk.summary: Severe VIX crisis regime (346.7) combined with flat yield curve and negative macro score (-3) creates highly unfavourable conditions; earnings in 38 days adds moderate event risk but is not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term bullish structure (SMA 50/200 crossover, supertrend bullish) combined with extreme fear sentiment (11/100) and contrarian buy signal creates asymmetric risk/reward for patient entry near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below both 50-SMA and Ichimoku cloud with negative intermediate momentum (AO, EMA 9/21), VIX crisis regime (346.7), unfavorable macro (-3), congressional insider selling, and no strategy triggered—swing entry probability severely compromised.

decision.entry_rationale: Long-term bullish structure (SMA 50/200, supertrend) and extreme fear sentiment (11/100) offer contrarian appeal, but intermediate technicals are decisively bearish with price trapped below 50-SMA and Ichimoku cloud, negating swing entry probability.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis regime (346.7) combined with unfavorable macro environment (-3) and congressional insider selling create systemic headwinds that override technical setup; earnings in 38 days add event risk during volatile period.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, fundamental, risk, and debate agents all converge on bearish intermediate outlook despite long-term bullish structure
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding UNH with 39 existing Health Care positions (8.9% sector concentration); adding to this concentration during VIX crisis and macro deterioration violates prudent risk management.
